title: 3-Ingredient Apple Cake
description: Just applesauce, gelatine and whey protein — whipped into a light, mousse-like cake that sets in the fridge. Extraordinarily simple.
steps: Add applesauce to a pot; heat on medium 1 minute.
Add gelatine; mix well until fully dissolved.
Transfer immediately to a large bowl. Beat with a hand mixer 10–15 minutes until foamy and whitish.
Add protein powder and cinnamon; mix 30 seconds.
Line a 20×20cm (8×8in) container with plastic foil; pour in mixture; spread evenly.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours until firm. Slice and serve.
notes: Top with skyr for extra protein. Add 25g sweetener and 1 tsp cinnamon for more flavour. Lasts 2–3 days in fridge.
